study_info.description: One-line summary of what the trial studies, from the titles and summary.

arms.description: The trial's planned participant groups, one entry per line of the record's 'Arms' block. Protocol-as-planned: an arm has no enrolled count, no metrics and no adverse events, even on a record that posts results; what a group was actually given belongs to 'as_run_arms'.

arm_name.description: The group's name as the protocol writes it, without the parenthesised role, e.g. 'Rucaparib'.

arm_type.description: The group's role as rendered in parentheses on its line, e.g. 'experimental', 'active comparator', 'placebo comparator'. Null when the line carries no role.

dosage.description: Planned dose, route or schedule for this arm, only when the record states one, e.g. '300 mg twice daily'. Null otherwise.

inclusion_criteria.description: One entry per distinct requirement a participant must meet to enrol, split out of the registry's free-text criteria blob. Split compound criteria into separate entries when they state independent requirements.

text.description: The requirement as a short standalone clause, e.g. 'Age 18 years or older'.

exclusion_criteria.description: One entry per distinct condition that disqualifies a participant, split out of the registry's free-text criteria blob.

text.description: The disqualifying condition as a short standalone clause.

genetic.description: Gene/protein biomarkers explicitly named in the registry record.

text.description: HGNC symbol for the gene/protein explicitly named in the anchored sentence. Normalize registry aliases (e.g. p16→CDKN2A, HER2→ERBB2).

evidence_anchor.description: Verbatim phrase naming this same biomarker (symbol, protein, or alias).

role.description: inclusion: required for enrollment; exclusion: disqualifies enrollment; other: biomarker named outside the entry criteria.

as_run_arms.description: How each group was actually dosed, one entry per line of the 'Results groups' block. As-run, so it may differ from 'arms': groups merge, a dose-finding cohort splits, a planned arm never enrols. Empty when the record has no results.

group_label.description: The group's title, copied verbatim from the start of its line in 'Results groups'. Used to join back to the registry's own group records, so it must match exactly.

drug.description: The agent this group received, as named on the line. Null when the group received no agent, e.g. a placebo or observation group.

dose.description: Dose with its unit, e.g. '240 mg/m^2'. Null when the line states none.

route.description: Route of administration, e.g. 'IV', 'oral'. Null when unstated.

schedule.description: Dosing schedule as stated, e.g. 'once daily on Days 1 to 3 of each 21-day cycle'. Null when unstated.

randomization.description: How participants were assigned, when the results prose states it. Null when the record does not.

ratio.description: Allocation ratio as written, e.g. '1:1'. Null when unstated.

stratification_factors.description: Factors randomisation was stratified by, e.g. 'ECOG performance status (0 to 1 versus 2)'. Empty when none stated.

evidence_anchor.description: Null when nothing was found for this field.

recruitment.description: Recruitment context from the results prose. Every member is null when the record has no results. Site counts and countries are omitted on purpose: the registry publishes them as structured location records.

window.description: When recruitment ran, as stated, e.g. 'January 2015 to August 2016'. Null when unstated.

channel.description: How participants were found, e.g. 'advertisements around campus and the Pitt+Me registry'. Null when unstated.

evidence_anchor.description: Null when nothing was found for this field.
